name: Hai Duong Provincial Data Center (Trung tam Du lieu tinh Hai Duong)
developer: Hai Duong provincial authorities / Department of Information and Communications
notes: Official Hai Duong provincial ICT portal reports the provincial data center formally entered operation on 11 Jan 2024 with maximum storage capacity of 384 TB, hosting official email, citizen app and justice micro-certificate systems. Public-sector facility, no commercial MW; method-driven search corrected the first-round no_projects flag.

name: Ha Nam Smart Operations Center (IOC) with provincial data platform
developer: Ha Nam Provincial People's Committee with VNPT
notes: Province-wide smart operations center launched 27 Mar 2020 integrating departmental systems and big-data analytics for e-government (Ha Nam was a national e-government pilot 2019-2020); operates on provincial data-center infrastructure. No standalone commercial colocation identified; civic scale, no MW.

name: Hung Yen Data and Digital Transformation Center (Trung tam Du lieu va Chuyen doi so Hung Yen)
developer: Hung Yen Department of Science and Technology / provincial government
notes: Provincial Decision 47/2025/QD-UBND establishes the Data and Digital Transformation Center under the Department of Science and Technology operating the provincial data/digital infrastructure; Nhan Dan also reports Hung Yen pushing data-infrastructure buildout toward 2030. Public-sector center, not commercial colocation; no MW.

name: Hung Yen eco-industrial park and data center investment proposal
developer: Undisclosed private investors / Hung Yen provincial authorities
notes: Local press reports provincial leaders worked with two businesses on proposed investments in an eco-industrial park and data center; early-stage proposal, no investment certificate or land evidence yet, no capacity disclosed.

name: Nam Dinh Provincial Integrated Data Center
notes: VietnamNet (sourced from provincial media) reports shared provincial digital services are to be managed/operated at the Nam Dinh integrated data center by 2025, with development through 2030 using government cloud, big data and links to national/regional data centers. Status planned (target/roadmap not commissioning); no MW.

name: Phu Tho Provincial Digital Data Center
notes: Provincial digital data center reported operating 24/7 for storage, processing and data connections among state agencies; capacity in MW not disclosed, public-sector scale.

name: KCTC / ThePRECON Thai Nguyen Data Center
developer: KCTC Vietnam and ThePRECON Co., Ltd. (Korea)
notes: MoU signed 19 Jun 2025 between Thai Nguyen UBND and KCTC Vietnam + ThePRECON for a data center investment of about USD 200 million with minimum 20 MW capacity; Korean embassy attended. Status planned (signed cooperation MoU; no IRC/land/construction yet).

name: Thai Nguyen Provincial Data Center
notes: Thai Nguyen launched its provincial data center on 2026-03-13, connecting live to 92 commune/ward bridges; includes shared data warehouse, smart operations center (IOC) and upgraded C-ThaiNguyen platform. Public-sector facility, no MW disclosed.

name: Vinh Phuc Provincial Data Center
notes: Provincial Decision 41/2022/QD-UBND defines management/operation of the Vinh Phuc provincial data center; later government coverage says the provincial data center and large enterprise data centers in the province operate effectively. Public-sector scale; no MW.

name: Dien Bien Provincial Data Center
developer: Dien Bien Department of Science and Technology / provincial government
notes: Provincial data center operates 54 physical servers and 835 TB storage to support centralized storage and digitized records for the two-level local government; public-sector facility, no commercial MW.

name: Dak Nong Integrated Data Center (Trung tam Tich hop du lieu Dak Nong)
notes: Provincial Decision 10/2017/QD-UBND governs management and operation of the Dak Nong integrated data center; later coverage says the provincial digital-transformation data center operates 69 virtualized servers. Public-sector facility, no MW.

name: Hau Giang Provincial Data Center
notes: Government portal coverage says Hau Giang was directed to keep its data center and shared digital platforms operating effectively; Nhan Dan also notes a provincial data center using cloud technology. Public-sector scale, no MW.

name: Mekong Delta Regional Data Center (MONRE, Can Tho)
developer: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment / regional government stakeholders
notes: VietnamPlus/VNA report the inauguration of the Mekong Delta regional data center in Can Tho (under MONRE), integrating multi-sector data (environment, agriculture, socio-economics) for regional policy-making. Public-sector regional facility, no MW.

name: VDC2 Can Tho Data Center
notes: Aggregate/vendor article states VDC2 launched large data centers including one in Can Tho; weak evidence retained because an official current facility page was not found.

name: Da Nang Data Center at Da Nang Hi-Tech Park
developer: Da Nang International Data Centre JSC
notes: Groundbreaking at Lot H4, Da Nang Hi-Tech Park; 1,000 racks, 18.5 MW IT load, TIA-942C Rated-3/Tier-3 design, phase-1 investment about VND 800bn (phase 2 ~VND 1,200bn); city portal and local press confirm; operations expected 2026-2027.

name: AIDC DeCenter Da Nang AI Data Center
notes: Government portal and Da Nang startup portal report launch of a USD 200 million AI data center project at Da Nang Hi-Tech Park (Lien Chieu ward); registered investment up to USD 200m with phase 1 at USD 20m; no confirmed MW figure.

name: FPT Data Center Da Nang
notes: FPT internal news reported topping-out at F-City, Hoa Hai, Ngu Hanh Son with completion scheduled June 2024; contractor page lists FPT Data Center Da Nang, developer FPT Telecom. No MW disclosed.

name: Viettel IDC Da Nang Data Center
notes: DCD reports Viettel IDC operates data centers across Hanoi, Da Nang and Ho Chi Minh City; Baxtel lists the Da Nang facility as operational since May 2014. No MW disclosed.

name: VNPT IDC An Don Da Nang
notes: Data center directories list VNPT IDC An Don in Da Nang (~300 sqm, 20+ Gbps connectivity); directory-level evidence only, no official capacity.

name: Viettel IDC Hoa Lac 1
notes: Viettel inaugurated flagship Hoa Lac 1 at Hoa Lac Hi-Tech Park in Apr 2024: ~21,000 sqm, 2,400 racks, ~30 MW power, TIA-942 Rated 3, first in Vietnam integrating ~30% renewable power for AI/HPC workloads.

name: Viettel IDC Hoa Lac 3
notes: Viettel IDC's sixth data center at Hoa Lac: ~13,000 sqm and 2,500+ racks, first facility in Vietnam with an ANSI/TIA-942 Rated-4 component; entered operation around Mar 2026, PUE below 1.5; MW not disclosed.

name: VNPT IDC Hoa Lac
notes: VNPT inaugurated Hoa Lac IDC on 25 Oct 2023: up to 23,000 sqm usable floor and 2,000 racks, billed as Vietnam's largest/most modern at the time; Uptime Tier III (TCCF) design. No MW disclosed.

name: FPT Fornix HN01 and HN02 (Cau Giay)
notes: FPT Fornix HN01 (8-storey FORNIX building, Cau Giay, ~1,250 racks) and HN02 (10 Pham Van Bach, Cau Giay, up to ~1,500 racks) are two of FPT's four large Fornix data centers (total >17,000 sqm / >7,000 racks). Directory + official brochure evidence.

name: CMC Telecom Data Center Duy Tan (Cau Giay)
notes: CMC Telecom's Duy Tan (Cau Giay) data center earned Uptime Institute M&O certification, a first for a Vietnamese operator; CMC Tower also hosts the AWS Direct Connect location announced Dec 2025. No MW disclosed.

name: National Data Center No.1 (Hoa Lac)
notes: Ministry of Public Security inaugurated National Data Center No.1 at Hoa Lac Hi-Tech Park on 18 Aug 2025 - a >20 ha campus among the largest in Southeast Asia (approved under Resolution 175/NQ-CP, 30 Oct 2023). Sovereign public-sector facility; MW not disclosed.

name: AWS Direct Connect Hanoi @ CMC Tower (AWS connectivity location)
notes: AWS officially opened its first Direct Connect location in Vietnam inside CMC Tower, Hanoi (16 Dec 2025), 1/10/100 Gbps dedicated connections; connectivity/colo-adjacent evidence at CMC's Hanoi facility, not an AWS-owned datacenter building. AWS Hanoi Local Zone GA June 2026 per methodology.

name: VNPT - LG CNS - KIRA hyperscale AI data center
developer: VNPT with LG CNS and Korea Investment Real Asset Management (KIRA)
notes: Cooperation agreement (19 Oct 2025) to jointly develop a hyperscale AI data center meeting international standards; site not disclosed (listed under Hanoi as VNPT Group base); capacity unconfirmed, status announced.

name: Evolution Data Centers VN01 Hanoi (Hoa Lac)
notes: Industry research reports Evolution's VN01 Hanoi at Hoa Lac Hi-Tech Park already operational; the firm plans VN02 HCMC (52 MW, SHTP, RFS Q4 2027). Weak/aggregate evidence for VN01.

name: NTT Hanoi Thang Long Data Center (Van Phuc, Ha Dong)
notes: NTT-operated colocation data center in Hanoi with ~6,000 sqm colocation space per directory listings; directory-level evidence only.

name: Viettel IDC Hoang Hoa Tham (Hanoi, legacy)
notes: Legacy Viettel IDC facility on Hoang Hoa Tham street, Hanoi, listed among Viettel's Hanoi data centers by a reseller page; no official capacity disclosed.

name: MobiFone Hai Phong Data Center
notes: MobiFone Service Company (Region 5) introduced Hai Phong's first data center at the MobiFone building, 68 Pham Van Dong, Anh Dung ward, Duong Kinh district (8 floors + 1 basement) on 17 Apr 2025; about 50 racks per floor, expandable to ~120; part of MobiFone's 7-data-center national portfolio.

name: Viettel Tan Phu Trung (TPTIP) Data Center
notes: Groundbreaking ~24 Apr 2025 at Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, Cu Chi district: Vietnam's first >100 MW hyperscale data center, up to 140 MW, ~10,000 racks, ~40,000 sqm on a 4 ha site, Uptime Tier III, PUE<1.4; Phase 1 targeted Q1 2026, full build-out before 2030.

name: CMC Hyperscale Data Center (Saigon Hi-Tech Park)
notes: SHTP Management Board officially approved CMC's hyperscale data center investment (late Jun 2025): USD 250M+, initial 30 MW expandable to 120 MW IT load, AI/cloud/big-data focus with NVIDIA GH200 GPU farm; construction slated to begin 2026.

name: SGI-HCM AI Data Center Campus (KBC + AIC + VietinBank)
developer: Kinh Bac City Development (KBC), Accelerated Infrastructure Capital (AIC), VietinBank
notes: ~USD 2 billion AI data center campus on a 10 ha site in Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, HCMC, designed for up to 200 MW IT load and ~100,000 GPUs; MoU with VietinBank; HCMC set up a fast-track task force and construction was targeted to begin 30 Apr 2025. Still MoU/planning stage - no IRC/construction evidence confirmed.

name: NTT Ho Chi Minh City 1 Data Center (NTT GDC + QD.TEK)
developer: NTT Global Data Centers & Quang Dung Technology (QD.TEK) joint venture
notes: JV 'NTT GDC HCMC1 LLC' building Vietnam's first global carrier-neutral data center at Saigon Hi-Tech Park: 5-storey, ~6 MW IT capacity across 3,100 sqm server rooms (~1,200 racks) on a 10 ha plot; cornerstone laid 12 Dec 2024; originally targeted 2024 launch.

name: STT VNG Ho Chi Minh City 1
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres & VNG Corporation (JV)
notes: Formerly the VNG Data Center (7,800 sqm, ~12,400 sqm usable) at Tan Thuan EPZ, District 7; Uptime Tier-3, ISO 27001/27017/27018, PCI-DSS; 9.6 MW IT load; HCMC's first carrier-neutral connectivity hub.

name: STT VNG Ho Chi Minh City 2
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres & VNG Corporation (JV)
notes: Second STT-VNG facility in the Tan Thuan cluster designed for up to 60 MW IT load, linked to STT VNG HCMC1 with substation and expressway access; announced/planning stage, no construction evidence found at check date.

name: Evolution DC VN HCMC (VN02, Saigon Hi-Tech Park)
notes: Hyperscale data center at Saigon Hi-Tech Park; investment registration certificate granted ~Apr 2026; USD 508.8M, 52 MW, Uptime Tier III design upgradeable to Tier IV; RFS targeted Q4 2027.

name: StarMason Hyperscale Data Center (Sembcorp + BB Holdings)
notes: HCMC People's Committee granted IRCs in late Apr 2026 to four SHTP high-tech projects (>USD 1.23bn total), incl. the StarMason hyperscale data centre complex: >USD 480M, 60 MW IT load (DCD headline cited 90 MW), Sembcorp Development JV with BB Holdings.

name: FPT Fornix HCM01 and HCM02
notes: FPT Fornix HCM01 (HCMC) and HCM02 (inaugurated late 2023, District 9/Thu Duc adjacent to SHTP, ~10,000 sqm, ~3,600 racks) are two of FPT's four Fornix data centers; operational colocation/cloud facilities.

name: VNPT IDC Tan Thuan
notes: VNPT IDC Tan Thuan (Lot VA, 02C-03A Street 24, Tan Thuan EPZ, District 7) operational since end-2015; ~10,000 sqm, ~750 racks, Tier 3 certified; a 2026 Alibaba Cloud operations job posting places staff at this facility.

name: CMC Data Center Tan Thuan
notes: CMC's flagship colocation data center at Tan Thuan EPZ, District 7; designed to PCI DSS, ISO 27001:2013 and ISO 9001:2015; inaugurated with the State President attending. No MW disclosed.

name: Viettel IDC Ho Chi Minh City (existing facilities)
notes: Before the Tan Phu Trung campus, Viettel IDC operated five data centers across Hanoi (x2), Da Nang (x1) and HCMC (x2) totalling ~25,000 sqm; the two HCMC facilities are operational colocation/cloud sites.

name: True IDC Tan Thuan and QTSC Data Center
developer: True IDC (True Corporation) / Quang Trung Software City (QTSC)
notes: Directory listings: True IDC Tan Thuan ~10,000 sqm / ~1,200 racks; QTSC data center within Quang Trung Software Park, District 12 (smaller facility). Directory-level evidence only.

name: MobiFone Data Center Ho Chi Minh City
notes: MobiFone reports equipping/operating data centers in Hai Phong, Da Nang, HCMC and Dong Nai toward a seven-data-center national portfolio by 2025; HCMC facility details and capacity not separately disclosed.
